g.text: Fresh seed: a modest physical gain, with real regressions
Settings selected using seed 12, then frozen before seed 29. Eight conditions; same objects, not unseen-object generalization.
Unchanged selections reuse the identical baseline result. Hammer physical success drops, while handle-compatible success improves.
